title: Malicious code in @bigdevin55/calculator-install-demo (npm)
description: The npm package @bigdevin55/calculator-install-demo contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or executed. The compromise may allow an attacker to gain full control over the affected system, risking exposure of all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets from a different, uncompromised device is strongly advised.
